dogecoin.text: Honestly, I would love nothing more than for #dogecoin to make me extremely rich and people to complain and ask what talent I have or what I did to deserve my wealth. What a great problem that would be to have.

I’d like to formally announce that I am now accepting Dogecoin as payment. I have not yet determined what you are paying for, but you are welcome to begin making pre-sale payments via Doge. Thank you.
